title: Knowledge base entity
description: One API name the corpus documents, with everything the corpus says about it. Written by tools/build-kb.py to knowledge/kb/entities.jsonl(.gz).

id.description: Canonical lookup key: the name lowercased with '::' and punctuation removed (tools/ce_api_names.py normalize()).

name.description: Display name as a page prints it (the most common one).

layers.description: Which corpus layers document the name.

doc_role.description: DERIVED from the corpus. api-definition: a page prints a syntax block. api-page: a page looks like reference (Header/Library/DLL/OS-version requirements) but prints no syntax block. topic: the name is only the title of a prose page.

kind_evidence.description: Where the kind came from. null when no evidence decided it.

name_evidence.description: How the name was taken from the source pages.

ce_sets.description: Corpus-relative set directories of the CE pages (e.g. learn/windows-embedded-ce-6.0). This is the version scope of the entity.

headers.description: Header names stated by the pages (Header / req.header). Values are quoted, not normalised.

libraries.description: Link libraries stated by the pages (Link Library / Library / req.lib).

dlls.description: DLL names stated by the pages (DLL / req.dll / api_location).

declarations.description: Ids of declarations.jsonl records for this entity (all roles).

syntax_declarations.description: The subset whose role is 'syntax': the entity's own declaration, not a quoted example.

noise.description: DERIVED flag for a name that is not an API. Only one pattern is certain enough to flag: an all-caps double-underscore identifier (__COMMONPUBROOT) that a page's code block mentioned. Flagged records stay in the file (and in reports/coverage.tsv); reports/gaps.tsv skips them.

modules.description: sdk-api module the page belongs to (from the page's UID, e.g. 'fileapi'). The Win32-side grouping; CE pages state no module.

relations.description: DERIVED links to other definitions, each with the evidence it was read from. Every entry is a lead with its page, never a merged claim.

id.description: Canonical id of the target, '' when the relation has no single target (type 'layer').

present.description: Whether that target exists as an entity in this file.

evidence.description: The printed text the relation was read from.

page.description: Corpus-relative page the evidence is on.

generation_use.description: DERIVED, rule-based: which part of an include/def generator this record can feed. include-declaration = a syntax declaration plus a stated header; type-definition = struct/enum/union/typedef; link-library = a function/callback with a stated library or DLL; def-export = a function/callback with a stated DLL; abi-layout = a struct/union whose declaration lists members; abi-members = only the documented member list exists (documented_fields, names and order, no offsets); unicode-mapping = it has a unicode-ansi relation; version-scope = it names the CE sets that document it; ce-restriction = it has constraint sentences.

documented_fields.description: DERIVED from the page's own '-struct-fields' section: the member names, in documented order, of a structure whose page prints no declaration body (840 of the 842 sdk-api pages with such a section; only WIN32_FIND_DATAA/W print both). Names and order only; the pages state no offsets. Identity/deduplication is by name, first occurrence wins.

documented_fields_page.description: Corpus-relative page the documented_fields were read from; null when there are none.

variants_of.description: DERIVED. Set by tools/build-kb.py fold_variants() when this entity is a Unicode/ANSI spelling of a base name: {"name", "id", "kind" (unicode|ansi), "basis", "evidence", "page"}. basis says what the link rests on: page-statement (the page's own "X (Unicode) and Y (ANSI)" text) or import-rule (data/reports/win32-shared.tsv imports this page under the Windows CE name). A spelling whose page states no base and was not imported under one stays null.

variants.description: DERIVED. The variant spellings linked to this base name, each with name, id, kind, basis, evidence, page and the win32_pages it contributes.

win32_pages_from_variants.description: DERIVED. Win32 reference pages that document an A/W spelling of this base name (they stay in that spelling's own entity as well).

win32_documented.description: DERIVED. True when the Win32 reference documents this name, directly (win32_pages) or through a variant spelling (win32_pages_from_variants).

surface.description: DERIVED. Where the name belongs in the Windows CE / Win32 split (classify_surface()). Windows CE is the CE-specific surface plus the Win32 that the CE documents share, not all of Win32: ce-only (only CE documents it), shared (CE and the Win32 reference both do), win32-spelling (a Win32 page for an A/W spelling of a documented CE name), catalog-only (only the official CE catalog names it -- the Win32 page is the only documentation held, a collection lead), win32-only (a Win32 page not tied to a CE name).

licenses.description: Scope ids of every page that documents this name (a shared name can have a CE page and a Win32 page under different statements).

documented_fields_pages.description: Every page that documents members of this entity (the union in documented_fields can span the A and W pages).

documented_field_pages.description: field name -> the page that documents it (the page behind kb/struct-fields.tsv).

abi.description: Derived roll-up of what the entity's records state about themselves: calling_conventions (only what a page prints), declarations_without_convention, syntax_declarations, declared_members, typed_members, bitfield_members, flags, notes (quoted abi-note sentences), documented_offsets with offset_pages (rows of layout tables on its pages), stated_size_bytes (read from the quoted structure-size sentences). Nothing is inferred; an absent convention or offset stays absent.
